usage: agentbreeder mcp [-h] {grant,revoke} ...

positional arguments:
  {grant,revoke}
    grant         Grant TOOLs of SERVER to AGENT in stack.yaml (shown as a
                  diff)
    revoke        Revoke TOOLs of SERVER from AGENT in stack.yaml (shown as a
                  diff)

options:
  -h, --help      show this help message and exit
